Mentioned by 'Gos lo tsA ba (ID:5839) ([7V8MZYAI]: 4) and listed in A khu ching Shes rab rgya mtsho's Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 523, No. 11332: gro lung pa [...] mdzad pa'i rgyud bla ma'i Tik+ka) ([BAQ9MH4T]: 407).

According to 'Gos lo tsA ba, this commentary was based on rNgog Blo ldan shes rab's small commentary (ID:4441). See [7V8MZYAI]: 4 (rngog gis rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa la TI kA chung yang mdzad cing | de la brten nas gro lung pa dang | zhang tshes kyis kyang TI kA mdzad de |).
name: rgyud bla ma'i Tik+ka
